title: Scheduled Amazon EventBridge rule for AWS Lambda
description: Create an scheduled EventBridge rule that invokes a Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template deploys a Lambda function that is triggered by an EventBridge Schedule. In this example, the Lambda function logs text to the console every minute.
